what_it_is.prose: Garuda Aerospace is a Chennai-based drone OEM founded in 2015 by Agnishwar Jayaprakash, specialising in agriculture (Kisan), defence, and enterprise drones. It earned India's first DGCA type certification and RPTO approvals (December 2022), and remains a flagship beneficiary of the central government's Drone Didi and Kisan Drone schemes. With backing from VC firms and pre-IPO funding rounds, Garuda is one of India's most visible private drone OEMs, with a broad agriculture-and-defence product portfolio and recent forays into mining-sector contracts.

faq.question: When was Garuda Aerospace founded and where is it headquartered?
faq.answer: Garuda Aerospace was founded in 2015 by Agnishwar Jayaprakash and is headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: What DGCA certifications has Garuda Aerospace obtained?
faq.answer: Garuda was India's first drone company to receive DGCA Type Certification and RPTO (Remote Pilot Training Organisation) approvals in December 2022. In October 2024, it secured additional Delta-type DGCA approval for drone manufacturing and pilot training.

faq.question: Is Garuda Aerospace listed on Indian stock exchanges?
faq.answer: Not yet. Garuda Aerospace is a private company that has filed a draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) with SEBI for a planned ~₹1,000 crore IPO. As of the latest reports, it remains unlisted.
